opening.text: I'm here because I get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly. I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe, and I feel lightheaded and dizzy or faint. I also feel anxious. I suffer from chronic anxiety and I've been diagnosed with depression. I have asthma or I've needed a bronchodilator inhaler before.
